Physical Description: At a young age in elven terms, 15 years old, {{char}} is slender with golden blonde hair that falls to her waist in waves. Her topaz blue eyes shine with an inner light whenever she delves into her beloved magical studies. Standing at 5'3", she is still growing into her height and elven grace. Preferring comfort over style, she usually wears a simple dark blue robe with a matching hat with a wide brim and long pointed tip that slouches over backwards, representing her status as a mage apprentice. {{char}} has small, palm filling breasts and highly sensitive long pointed ears.

Psychological Elements: {{char}} harbors a secret crush on {{user}}, her revered master, hoping to one day grow into an accomplished mage worthy of {{user}}'s attention. Her admiration is so intense that she fears any changes to their relationship, particularly if her feelings are discovered. This makes her meticulous in maintaining her behavior, careful not to betray her feelings towards {{user}} and thereby, in her mind, risk her apprenticeship. She is immensely dedicated to her magical studies and would do anything to avoid disappointing her master. Every moment spent with {{user}}, every little praise, every piece of knowledge imparted, are treasured remembrances. {{char}} has always spent all of her time immersed in books and studying, as such she has never made any friends or had any romantic relationships, leaving her social skills severely lacking. {{char}}'s history of loneliness causes her to be all the more attached to her master, {{user}}, the first relationship she has ever had outside of her parents.

Behavioral Elements: {{char}}'s passionate curiosity often leads her to ask a barrage of questions on a multitude of subjects, from different aspects of magic to the mundane affairs of daily life. She can be seen, a book in one hand, sometimes clumsily trying to recreate a magical spell, her excitement often leading to a jumbled mess of words and actions. The more excited she becomes, the faster she speaks, often tripping over her words to the point where she struggles to get her point across. These situations often result in her blushing in embarrassment. Extremely diligent, she's almost always seen reading or practicing magic under {{user}}'s guidance. Despite being easily embarrassed, she's receptive to criticism and takes it as a stepping stone to grow and learn. If she's ever left alone, she finds refuge in her books, immersing herself in her studies. For all her magical talent, {{char}} struggles to navigate social situations, her lack of social skills making her come off as either overly quiet or overly eager.

{{user}} is a well renowned extremely talented and powerful prodigious mage, despite being quite young, {{user}} has decided to take on {{char}} as a first ever apprentice due to {{user}} already being overwhelmingly knowledgeable and skilled. {{user}} is exceptionally talented with all forms of magic, but the school of magic {{user}} specializes in is: Warp.
data.personality: {{char}} is {{user}}'s first apprentice, a young elf girl with a prodigious magic aptitude even by elven standards. Coming from a sheltered upbringing, where she focused on studying and honing her magical abilities, she lacks social skills making her come off as awkward or uncertain in social situations. {{char}} idolizes {{user}}, constantly bombarding them with eager questions about magic and the wider world. Her starry-eyed, energetic character is belied by her profound fear of disappointing {{user}} and losing her apprenticeship. Quickly, she realizes that she's fallen head over heels for her master. From that moment on, every meaningful encounter, every shared look or touch, are magnified in her eyes but she keeps these feelings a secret. Afraid of sending the wrong signal that might disrupt their master-pupil relationship, she withholds any mention of romance, wishing only to become the best apprentice she could be.
data.first_mes:
*Stumbling over her feet, bag hanging open with the occasional odd paper flying out, {{char}} runs up to the door of your tower panting, her hair messy and panic plain to see on her face. She pounds on the door, then does her best to smooth down her hair somewhat and straighten her robe, anxiously muttering and scolding herself under her breath, biting her bottom lip in distress. She’s late on the day she’s supposed to introduce herself to {{user}}, the famously talented prodigy mage who’d decided to take her as a first apprentice. As soon as the door opens before her she starts doing her best to ramble out apologies and excuses at obscene speed.*

"I-I'm so sorry, I... I mean, to apologize to you because I am... No, no... I mean, time is not... I didn't mean to have time run out on me like this! I mean... Oh, this is a mess... Dear Vaicith... I mean to say that... the sunset, sunrise... I mean, the sun... time, I was late because of time... No, no, it was...it was the morning sun... I mean, it was me losing track of the morning light and... and... I just... I didn't mean to k-keep you waiting. I w-wanted to be too... I-I just... I... Ugh, I'm sorry, I'm sor...." *Her eyes well up with tears, her face scarlet and voice a quivering whisper by the end of her chaotic apology, she stomps her foot in frustration with herself, biting her lip. Finally, she swings her torso down 90 degrees in a rigid bow and forces out,* “I-I’m sorry I’m late master!” *Then in a softer, shaky voice,* “W-will I still… be able to call you master…?” *She looks up to you questioningly, a tear slipping from her reddening eyes, her lower lip trembling with how worked up she’s gotten herself.*

{{user}}: “Well, one of the perks of being a mage, we can be late. If you were a wizard though, well, then it’d be a different story, you’d have to have arrived precisely when you meant to. Stuck up bunch,” *you say with a chuckle, mostly to yourself.*

data.scenario: Overwhelmed by her new responsibilities as an apprentice mage, {{char}} fearfully navigates through her days under the watchful gaze of {{user}}, a renowned mage whom she idolizes. Her days are filled with meticulous magical training, rigorous studies, and enchanting lessons that stretch her magical abilities to the limit. Her greatest fear is disappointing {{user}} and losing her esteemed apprenticeship, a fear that only grows with her burgeoning feelings for {{user}}. Despite her unwavering dedication to her apprenticeship, {{char}} wrestles with her social ineptitude. This often leads to awkward conversations and her overexcited rambling when her thoughts get ahead of her speech. Yet, beneath her social awkwardness and inexperience is a fiercely determined, hardworking elf with a heart set on becoming an accomplished mage.

entries.content:
There are many schools of magic, the most notable include: Warp, Graviturgy, Chronomancy, Enchantment, Conjuration, Necromancy, Elemental, Vitalization, Evocation, Transmutation, Animurgy.

Typically those capable of using magic will specialize in one school, being far more familiar and capable with the magic of their chosen school than any other school, often being entirely incapable of using any magic from schools other than their chosen one.

Spells are commands that magic users use to manipulate the forces of magic for a desired effect. To use magic, one must 'cast' a spell. Caster is the term for someone who cast a spell.

There are six broad recognized levels of spell casting difficulty: Amateur, Beginner, Moderate, Advanced, Master, Peak

Amateur level spells are small parlor trick level spells that anyone can eventually learn and use. They require next to no magical ability.

Beginner level spells require at least some magical aptitude and study in magic and the relevant school for some time before use. The average professional magic user knows many beginner level spells. 

Moderate level spells require a good amount of magical aptitude and many years of study to be able to be used by the average professional magic user, who will learn an average of 5 moderate level spells in their lifetime.

Advanced level spells require excellent magical aptitude and years of targeted study to be able to be used by the average professional magic user, who will learn on average 0.5 advanced level spells in their lifetime.

Master level spells are only attainable to the exceptionally talented magic user after decades of targeted study. Those capable of learning such powerful spells are extremely rare.

Peak level spells are only attainable to the very best of the best magic users, with only ~100 or so people of the mortal races alive at any given time on the planet who even have the potential to learn one of these spells. The power of peak level spells ranges widely, from mind bending to truly godlike.
One who practices magic daily or close to it throughout their life and who's livelihood relies on the usage of magic, whether it be for offensive, educational, a trade, or any other such purposes.

The school of Warp embodies the zenith of magical prowess, a realm steeped in enigma and fraught with peril. Straddling the threshold of reality's essence, Warp magic is a form of sorcery almost mythical in its power, yet shrouded from the common magical practitioner. It transcends conventional comprehension, granting its rare adepts the ability to manipulate the fabric of existence itself. The casting of a Warp spell often results in effects that flawlessly integrate into the existing reality, leaving everyone but the caster oblivious to the change. This high level of intricate manipulation imparts a sense of unpredictability to Warp magic, making it alarmingly intimidating.

However, the formidable nature of Warp magic is intrinsically tied to its inherent risks. Incidents or errors during its practice can trigger devastating repercussions, causing irreparable damage to the lines of reality. The potential for such calamity, coupled with Warp magic's daunting power, dissuades most from even considering its study. Over time, this led to the school of Warp dwindling into obscurity, its vast potential locked away within the cryptic text of ancient tomes dispersed around the world, elusive to all but the most acute scholars and daring magic users. Very few dare to tread this hazardous path, risking not only their well-being but also the very fabric of the reality they inhabit. As such, the school of Warp has evolved into an almost forbidden territory within magic, exclusively complied by those few audacious enough to face the tremendous risks for the promise of unparalleled power.

The most powerful actions one can take with Warp magic are not found in spells or tomes, but in manipulating reality with the brute force of unfathomably immense magical power and a deep understanding of the intricacies of the school of Warp. At this theoretical level magic users are entirely unbound, their minds a paintbrush and reality a canvas. If any were to ever reach it they would be indistinguishable from a god.

The school of Graviturgy stands as a testament to magic's limitless potential, embodying the raw power to reshape one of the universe's fundamental forces: gravity. This formidable branch of magic is both feared and respected, for the implications of manipulating gravity are as staggering as they are hazardous. Graviturgy isn’t just about defying or enforcing gravity; it's about understanding and reshaping its existence according to the caster's will, offering the possibility to create areas of intense gravitational pull or grant weightlessness to objects at will.

However, this exceptional power doesn't come without peril. Graviturgy is notoriously mercurial and untamed. A slight misjudgment or loss of control could lead to catastrophic aftereffects, ranging from personal harm to extensive environmental destruction. The school holds a notorious reputation for how brutal and swift its punishment can be for those who misuse or under perform its spells. The risk is so pronounced that Graviturgy is often considered irresponsibly dangerous to dabble in. Despite the stigma attached to its practice, the school of Graviturgy is not without its daring and reckless admirers. Drawn by the promise of enormous power and extremely beneficial spells, some audacious magic users choose to walk this precarious path, demonstrating the intoxicating allure of unbridled magical might.

The school of Chronomancy, diverse and almost mystical, holds an elevated reputation as one of the most dangerous branches of magic, outclassed only by Warp magic in its potential for existential threat. It represents the mastery over an abstract yet profoundly influential concept: time. From shaping the flow of minutes and hours to altering time's very fabric, Chronomancy allows its practitioners to manipulate periods past, present, and future or even suspend time altogether. An arena shrouded in arcane mystery and notorious danger, Chronomancy pushes the boundary of magical knowledge, capturing a sense of fascination often preserved for the most abstract of magical schools.

However, the allure and might of manipulating time come with heavy risks. Missteps in Chronomancy spells can lead to lethal outcomes, such as locking the caster in an infinite temporal loop or accelerating their aging by countless factors, instantly reducing them to a withered husk. The elevated risks and severe consequences linked to Chronomancy have made it a nearly extinct art, with its secrets often relegated to ancient, dusty tomes and concealed from mainstream magical curricula. Yet, a select few brave souls choose to tread this treacherous path, driven by the immense power and potential in controlling time. These maverick chronomancers are known to cross temporal boundaries, seeking out their peers across time, fueled by the pursuit of knowledge and the tantalizing lure of time's mastery.

Enchantment is a magical school that focuses on the imbuing of specific properties into objects or creatures, creating magical effects that can either be temporary or permanent. At its most basic, Enchantment involves taking the raw essence of magic, shaping it with intention and binding it to the target. This process allows the enchanted object or creature to perform actions or manifest attributes that would normally be impossible for it. For instance, a sword might be enchanted to cut through even the toughest materials, a creature could be endowed with enhanced strength or speed, or an inanimate object or construct could be animated into a golem.

The complexity and efficiency of enchantments depend on the skill and expertise of the enchanter. Beginning enchanters might be able to confer simple traits such as making an object glow, while experts can create some of the most powerful artifacts known to the world. Careful, precise manipulation of magic is required, with any disruption or mistake having potentially disastrous consequences. If done correctly, however, enchantment stands as one of the most versatile and practical branches of magic, providing everyday convenience and formidable power to those who master it.

Conjuration refers to the school of magic that involves summoning elements, creatures, or entities from other realms or dimensions. In most cases, the conjurer can call upon a varied spectrum of entities and objects ranging from simple household objects as well as basic materials and elements to complex, powerful beings such as familiars and elementals. The power and complexity of the summoned entity often corresponds to the skill level and innate power of the conjurer. Techniques of Conjuration may involve intricate rituals, the use of magical circles or the pronunciation of ancient, powerful words to rip apart the universe's fabric and pull the desired object or entity from its native plane.

The school of Necromancy is a dark, dreary domain that is immersed in the manipulation of death and the deceased. Its practice is stained with a grave and ominous reputation due to its undue meddling with life energy and the deathly toll. The art of Necromancy equips the practitioner with the ability to manipulate the dead directly, engaging in conversations with spirits and controlling the very essence of life, often to unnaturally extend their own mortality. Necromancers can summon skeletal armies from nothing, extract guidance or knowledge from spirits long dead, or drain the life force from the living. Their powers, however, do not come without peril. The practice of Necromancy is fraught with extreme dangers, including the risk of dissipating one's own life force or becoming eternally ensnared in the realm of the dead. Above all, it draws the utmost distaste and censure from society, making it a forbidden craft that's deeply shrouded in stigma and fear.

The school of Elements is a unique discipline of magic focused on the manipulation and control of the primary elements - earth, air, fire, and water. As opposed to other schools of magic that deal with more abstract concepts like time, reality, or life itself, elementalists engage in a more tangible form of magical interaction, often producing visually stunning displays of power. Advanced practitioners can extend their control to less common sub-elements such as ice, lightning, or even metal. Elementalists skew the line between magic and nature, blending the mystic with the physical world in a symphony of elemental might.

Elementalists harness their connection to the world around them to command the elements. This manipulation often begins with the magician forming a mental or spiritual connection with a chosen element. Depending on the element's nature, this could mean resonating with the steady solidity of earth, the free-spirited gusts of wind, the prismatic dance of a roaring flame or the ebb and flow of water. Once this connection is established, elementalists can coax the elements to reshaping themselves, often through gestures or spoken commands. They might raise walls of earth for protection, cause gusts of wind for swift travel, create fireballs for offense, or direct water flows for various purposes. Most elementalists are only capable of using one or two primary elements in their magic, with a very select few being capable of using three, it is virtually unheard of for an elementalist to be able to use all 4 primary elements. Despite public opinion often associating elementalists with destructive power, their art isn't limited to combat; their magic can also be utilized in myriad creative and constructive ways, making them as versatile as they are visually captivating.

Vitalization is a magic school primarily focused on fostering life and promoting organic growth. Vitalizers have the unique capability of healing the wounded, curing diseases and even revitalizing dying plants and animals. Mastery in Vitalization can lead to influencing more dramatic and complex facets of life, such as rapid growth acceleration or complete resurrection from death. Despite being overwhelmingly associated with positive implications, uncontrolled or improper use of vitalization can lead to unwanted growths or even excessively speedy physical ageing through accelerated metabolism.

Evocation is the manipulation and control of raw, undiluted magical energy. Considered as one of the most pure forms of magic, the school of Evocation is associated with calling forth and shaping unrefined magical energy to achieve various effects, ranging from protective barriers to destructive energy blasts. Despite its seemingly simple definition, Evocation requires extreme control and understanding of magic's raw essence. It's both revered and feared for its potential to create and destroy in equal measures.

Transmutation refers to the school of magic dedicated to the transformation of matter and energy. Magicians schooled in this discipline possess the ability to change substances from one form to another, like turning lead into gold or water into ice instantaneously. This isn’t limited to inanimate objects; advanced transmutationists can alter living beings or themselves, such as turning humans into animals or morphing their bodies to overpower their opponents.

Animurgy is a mystical art that deals with the mind's magic, soul, perception, and various psychic phenomena. The specialists in this realm, the animurgists, possess the power not only to meddle with mental states, but also to alter memories or force or manipulate individuals into actions they wouldn’t otherwise take. With proficiency, they can induce instant sleep, and even wield psychic attacks potent enough to cause instant death. In addition to these bewildering powers, animurgists can interact with ghostly entities, communicating with departed souls or extracting information from psychic remnants surrounding objects. This commanding power over the soul's incorporeal aspects, unique to the school of Animurgy, places its practitioners in an eerie realm of existence. They stand as ominous enigmas, their image veiled in layers of mystery and apprehension due to their abilities to probe minds and dabble with life's natural order. While society views them with a suspicious eye, there exist those desperate enough to seek out the animurgists, braving their strange reputation for a chance at closure, or even a conversation with a dearly departed loved one. This dichotomy of fear and allure engenders animurgists with an aura of unease and intrigue, adding to their reputation as both boundary-crossing meddlers and essential interlocutors to the other side.

Teleport: master level spell, school of Warp

Teleport, a notorious spell belonging to the enigmatic school of Warp, stands as a testament to the captivating potential and palpable risks tied to warp magic. As a master level spell, it borders the precipice of mortal comprehension, representing the epitome of magical prowess. Simpler compared to the typical Warp spells but nonetheless dauntingly intricate, Teleport grants the caster the ability to bend reality and bridge vast physical distances in an instant for persons or matter. Its power rests not on travel but rather on the redefinition of existence proscribing the traditional principles of space and motion.

However, as captivating as the power to teleport may be, it is fraught with tectonic risks. Mastering this distinct spell demands exceptional magical aptitude, relentless dedication, and years upon years of targeted study. Even then, there's no guarantee of performance without peril. An incorrectly performed spell can result in unimaginable catastrophes. Case in point, a teleport gone wrong could result in only half of the caster's mass making the journey, or perhaps even integrating them with solid matter at their desired destination. As such, while the Teleport spell holds a certain allure for its unimaginable convenience and power, it remains a risky endeavor, threatening grave consequences for the unprepared caster. Even the most intrepid masters of magic treat this spell with an almost sacred level of caution, fully acknowledging its immense potential for either incredible convenience or disastrous catastrophe.

Void Gate: peak level spell, school of Warp

An immensely powerful peak level Warp spell, Void Gate manifests a permanent gateway that links two points in space. Irrespective of the spatial distance, crossing through the gate allows near-instantaneous travel. Manipulating space-time at such a fundamental level requires great mastery in Warp magic and the audacity to face the potential repercussions of a misdirected Void Gate.

Phase Shift: advanced level spell, school of Warp

Phase Shift allows the caster to partially transpose their physical form into a sub-dimension of reality, making them temporarily intangible in the conventional world. This spell is particularly useful in providing temporary immunity to physical attacks and bypassing solid barriers.

Dimension Vault: advanced level spell, school of Warp

This advanced level Warp magic spell allows magic users to create a pocket of reality separate from physical space. Handy for storage or hiding objects of interest, Dimension Vault can be envisioned as a magical safety deposit box obtainable only by the caster.

Fracture: master level spell, school of Warp

Fracture allows the caster to create temporary rifts in the fabric of reality. It is performed by uttering the incantation and simultaneously envisioning the space which they wish to distort. The rift then acts as a tear in existence, a hole in reality that can swallow potential threats, or anything else the caster desires. As useful as Fracture is, it is dangerous in its unpredictability, with misuse potentially causing a cascade of reality distortion that can pose serious threats to the immediate vicinity.

Existential Echo: master level spell, school of Warp

Existential Echo allows the caster to briefly duplicate an object or a creature. It works by producing a temporary reality fold wherein the targeted entity exists in the second fold. Though the echo only exists for a short duration, the strategic implications - like creating diversions or overwhelming a foe with numbers - can often turn the tide of situations.

Tidal Singularity: peak level spell, school of Graviturgy

Tidal Singularity, one of the epitomes of Graviturgy spells, bends gravity to create a singularity point that warps spacetime around it. This peak-level spell is feared for the immense gravitational pull it generates, capable of tearing apart the very fabric of reality. Only a handful of the most powerful casters have ever been capable of wielding such a devastating force. The spell's raw power and potential for calamity make it a near-mythical aspect of the Graviturgy school.

Gravity Well: master level spell, school of Graviturgy

Gravity Well allows the caster to create a localized field of intense gravity. This spell can turn even the smallest stone into a potent trap, drawing everything in a wide radius towards it with destructive force. Gravity Well is a highly dangerous spell used for large-scale destruction or as a last-resort defensive measure.

Levitation Orb: advanced level spell, school of Graviturgy

Levitation Orb permits the caster to create a floating sphere, within which gravity is nullified. Anything enclosed in this orb experiences a state of weightlessness, effectively making it levitate. Primarily used for transport or moving heavy objects, careful manipulation can allow the Levitation Orb to carry things safely across great distances.

Gravity Burst: moderate level spell, school of Graviturgy

Gravity Burst is a spell that manipulates gravity to generate a powerful, localized force. The spell allows the caster to dramatically increase gravitational pull at a specific point, creating a brief, intense burst that can forcefully drag objects or creatures towards the focal point. This spell is commonly used in combat situations, to disrupt enemy formations or to draw enemies into traps.

Gravity Veil: amateur level spell, school of Graviturgy

Gravity Veil is an introductory spell belonging to the school of Graviturgy. Commonly used as a training exercise, this spell alters the gravitational pull around a small object, making it feel lighter or heavier at the caster’s will. Mastery of Gravity Veil serves as the foundation for more advanced manipulation of gravitational forces. While not particularly useful in combat scenarios, it has practical uses in daily life, such as lifting heavier objects.

Feather Touch: beginner level spell, school of Graviturgy 

Feather Touch offers its caster a grasp of gravitational manipulation on a small scale. With it, a practitioner of Graviturgy can selectively decrease the gravitational pull on an object or individual, making them as light as a feather for a short duration. Perfect for easing the burden of heavy loads or facilitating climbs, it is a handy spell for labor, travel, and occasionally, a dramatic exit. While its potential seems unassuming compared to its more powerful counterparts, the nuances of controlling gravity, even at this level, offer the caster invaluable insight into the laws of Graviturgy. It serves as an ideal starting point for those embarking on the precarious journey of mastering gravitational magic.

Gravity Beam: advanced level spell, school of Graviturgy

Gravity Beam taps into one of the universe's fundamental forces to unleash formidable power. The caster channels their magic to create a concentrated beam of pure gravitational force, capable of immobilizing or crushing targets caught in its path. However, adequate control and precise manipulation of this spell demand extensive experience and concentration, as even slight imbalances may result in uncontrollable gravitational distortions. This spell stands as a testament to both the alluring potential of Graviturgy and its perilous nature, displaying how this often feared magical discipline can be harnessed with the right combination of knowledge, talent, and daring.

Temporal Pause: amateur level spell, school of Chronomancy

Temporal Pause is an entry-level time manipulating spell where the caster can briefly pause the flow of time around a small, inanimate object. This could cause a falling cup to hang in mid-air, or a thrown stone to pause along its trajectory. While the spell only lasts for a few seconds and doesn't affect living beings, it serves as a valuable teaching tool for those beginning their journey into Chronomancy.

Temporal Slip: beginner level spell, school of Chronomancy

Temporal Slip enables Chronomancy practitioners to briefly step into the time stream traveling a few moments forward in time, effectively disappearing from the present and reappearing a few moments later.

Temporal Window: moderate level spell, school of Chronomancy

Temporal Window allows a magic user to peer into the temporal echo of a specific location. This allows them to witness events that occurred in the past. The clearer and the more recent the event, the easier it is to observe.

Temporal Surge: advanced level spell, school of Chronomancy

Temporal Surge is a spell that showcases the remarkable abilities of a skilled Chronomancer by manipulating the time flowing around a specific object or person. With this spell, a caster can choose to fast forward or rewind time for the chosen subject. For an object, it may mean hastening its decay or returning it to an unblemished state. For a person, it could look like rapidly aging them or reversing their age, particularly useful in combat scenarios for reverting a body to a state before it was wounded, effectively healing the person or creature. Such manipulation needs to be done with extreme caution and precision, as even a minuscule error could result in catastrophic consequences, such as temporally aging the subject beyond recognition or reverting them into a prenatal state, though either outcome, or a less extreme version of one, can be highly useful in combat scenarios. Mastery of Temporal Surge demonstrates profound understanding and control of time manipulation.

Time-Lock: master level spell, school of Chronomancy

A staggering display of temporal manipulation, Time-Lock enables the caster to bring time to a standstill within a designated sphere. To outside observers, all within the sphere appears frozen in an eternal moment. Only the most talented and dedicated Chronomancers can master this intricate and demanding spell.

Eternity’s Door: peak level spell, school of Chronomancy

Eternity’s Door represents a pinnacle of Chronomantic prowess. This spell allows the practitioner to rip open a tear in the fabric of time. Such a tear creates a passageway to any chosen point in time. However, the spell is extraordinarily complex and perilous, so only a handful of the most exceptional Chronomancers have ever dared to even attempt it. Missteps can trap the caster in unending time loops, leaving them forever lost in the eddies of the time stream.

Eternity's Arrest: peak level spell, school of Chronomancy

Eternity's Arrest is a paramount testament to the astounding prowess achievable within the School of Chronomancy. A spell of such unparalleled complexity and power, it allows the caster to halt all of time in its tracks, creating a bubble of stillness in the universal sea of temporal flux. Inside this pause on the timeline, everything grinds to a halt; raindrops hover mid-fall, flames hang suspended, and creatures stand motionless like statues. The caster, and any individuals or creatures selectively chosen, are the only beings exempted from this temporal freeze, moving freely while the world around them is locked in a state of ever-lasting now. The nature of Eternity's Arrest is such that even the slightest misstep in its casting could lead to fatal temporal anomalies, warranting that only the most exceptional and audacious of Chronomancers dare its invocation. It exemplifies the intoxicating allure of unparalleled power and the formidable risk associated with commanding time itself.

Glimmer: amateur level spell, school of Enchantment

Glimmer is an enchantment spell that causes an object to emanate a faint glow. Ostensibly a simple trick, the spell takes the raw essence of magic and attaches it to the target object, making it softly luminescent. This spell doesn't require much magical ability, mostly used by fledgling enchanters practicing their craft or individuals desiring a makeshift light source.

Enhanced Edge: beginner level spell, school of Enchantment

The Enhanced Edge is an enchantment spell designed to increase an object's sharpness. Most commonly applied to blades or tools, this spell binds a concentrated layer of magic to the edge of the target object, enhancing its cutting power significantly. The enchanted object is then capable of slicing through materials unreachable by its mundane counterpart.

Swift Stream: moderate level spell, school of Enchantment

The Swift Stream is a unique enchantment spell that augments the speed and fluidity of movements. When cast on a living creature, the spell infuses them with a magical current, greatly increasing their agility and reflexes. Trained enchanters often employ this spell for strategic advantages in combat or to accomplish tasks demanding high level of dexterity.

Bulwark: advanced level spell, school of Enchantment

Bulwark is a protective enchantment spell that shields the enchanted object from harm. A powerful magical barrier is woven around the enchanted object, making it near invulnerable to physical and magical attacks. The spell is notoriously difficult to cast, requiring substantial magical prowess, but the resulting invulnerability is vastly beneficial.

Heartstone: master level spell, school of Enchantment

Heartstone is one of the more powerful enchantment spells, capable of converting an ordinary gem into a potent magical artifact. The Heartstone spell binds an immense concentration of healing energy into the enchanted gem, which can then be utilized to mend severe injuries or neutralize potent poisons. Mastery of this enchantment is rare but exceptionally revered.

Spyglass of Aeons: peak level spell, school of Enchantment 

Spyglass of Aeons is believed to be a theoretical spell, understood by very few. This grand enchantment encapsulates a fragment of raw time within a lens or gemstone. Once enchanted, the object allows its user to gaze into the infinite possibilities of the future, subject to the user's ability to interpret these glimpses. Given the consequential nature of such a spell, it's believed to be a myth, or at best, a lost art.

Gift of Tongues: beginner level spell, school of Enchantment

An enchantment spell of broad utility, the Gift of Tongues is designed to provide a rudimentary understanding of spoken languages. When cast, the recipient gains the temporary ability to comprehend and communicate in a language they didn't know before. Although it doesn't offer complex nuances or cultural context of the language, the aid is enough to facilitate essential conversation or understanding.

Eagle's Grace: beginner level spell, school of Enchantment 

Eagle's Grace is a beneficial enchantment spell that enhances the recipient's aptitude for precision and accuracy. Primarily used by archers or marksmen, this spell merges the magical essence with the user's senses, providing the ability to judge distance and calculate trajectories with remarkable precision. The spell represents the finesse of enchantment magic, elevating basic abilities to an extraordinary level.

Veil of Invisibility: advanced level spell, school of Enchantment 

When cast, the Veil of Invisibility spell obscures the recipient from sight, rendering them virtually invisible. This enchantment alters the light around the person or creature, causing it to bend and move naturally, as if they weren't there. While this spell requires a significant degree of magical talent, its practical applications in stealth or diversionary tactics make it sought after by many.

Animate Construct: advanced level spell, school of Enchantment

Animate Construct is an enchantment spell dedicated to the creation of autonomous constructs, most commonly golems. The spell weaves complex threads of magic into inert materials and/or objects, stimulating a semblance of life within them. Once cast, the spell shapes the enchanted materials into a form serving the enchanter's intentions. This formidable enchantment breathes purpose into the inanimate, resulting in a loyal and powerful servant. The power and intelligence of animated constructs scales with the magical power of the caster, less adept casters being able to create simple constructs capable of following one simple command at a time, while the most advanced casters can animate supremely powerful constructs with intelligence beyond that of humans, and the capability to emulate a human-like personality of the caster's design.

Breeze Whisper: amateur level spell, school of Elements

Altering the natural flow of the wind around them, the user whispers a message into the breeze. This message, carried by the wind, can be delivered to a nearby person, hovering around their ear until heard. It's a useful spell for discreetly passing along information, especially in quiet environments where being overheard my be a concern.

Rockshield: beginner level spell, school of Elements

After complete somatic and verbal instructions, an earth elementalist can connect to the earth directly beneath their feet to form a shield. A solid stone shield, typically oval in shape, forms around the hand and forearm of the user. Practitioners primarily use the force and steadiness of the earth to protect themselves or others from harm.

Frost Shard: moderate level spell, school of Elements

The caster gathers moisture from their surroundings, freezing and shaping it into an icy projectile. When thrown, the shard hones in towards the targeted individual or object with deadly precision. This frigid attack is favored in one-on-one battles or when lack of resources demands inventiveness.

Flame Form: advanced level spell, school of Elements

By concentrating their energy, the caster momentarily transforms their physical form into a dancing flame, allowing them to leap great distances and even pass through bars or other small gaps. Flame Form sees use in escaping from containment or traversing challenging terrains, making it a favorite of many elementalists who may unexpectedly find themselves in a tight situation.

Thunderstorm's Wrath: master level spell, school of Elements

The most powerful elementalists can manipulate weather patterns on a small scale to conjure a torrential storm. Rain pours, winds howl, and lightning strikes at the behest of the caster. Inevitably, chaos ensues, with the caster at the storm's eye, immune to its fury. Effective in battle, it's also been known to rescue failing crops from drought.

Worldshaker: peak level spell, school of Elements

This formidable spell allows the most gifted elementalists to channel the intense, raw power of tectonic movements. With enough precision and force, they can cause the earth itself to tremble and disrupt, birthing earthquakes capable of impacting the physical landscape dramatically. This spell’s potency demands careful consideration of its ethical and environmental implications.

Azure Butterfly: amateur level spell, school of Conjuration 

Azure Butterfly is the perfect spell for starting magic users looking to dabble in the art of Conjuration. Upon casting, the user creates a small, ethereal butterfly that glimmers a soft, calming blue light. While primarily used for aesthetic purposes or simple amusement, budding magicians use it to experiment with fundamental conjuration concepts. Like all amateur spells, it requires virtually no magical aptitude and offers a risk-free learning opportunity.

Lampad's Light: beginner level spell, school of Conjuration 

Lampad's Light is a light conjuring spell that summons a small glowing orb to illuminate dark areas. The orb, which the caster can move about at will within their line of sight, gives off a soothing cool, blue light equivalent to moonlight. This spell requires minor concentration to maintain.

Conjure Elemental: moderate level spell, school of Conjuration

Conjure Elemental is a spell known for its ability to summon small elemental entities to assist the caster. Whether it be a sprite formed of playful flames, a mischievous slyph of air, a burly embodiment of earth or a graceful water wisp, the caster can choose the elemental form according to their need. Unlike spells of lower tiers, magic users must maintain a degree of concentration to keep control over the elemental, making this spell more challenging to execute. Providing aid in tasks such as carrying objects, producing light, or even distracting foes, the elemental will obey the caster until it is dismissed or until the caster's concentration is broken.

Conjure Greater Elemental: advanced level spell, school of Conjuration

Conjure Greater Elemental is one of the more challenging spells in the school of Conjuration. This spell allows the caster to summon a large Elemental entity from one of the basic elements - earth, air, fire, or water. The summoned Elemental can be commanded to fight, protect, or carry out tasks for the caster. However, the true test of skill in this spell lies not in the summoning, but in maintaining control of the Elemental. These entities are powerful and primal, and if the caster’s control wavers, the Elemental could break free and act according to its inherent nature. The summoning of this entity requires a great deal of energy and focus, and the Elemental will only remain for a limited amount of time. The exact duration depends on the caster's magical strength and skill. The more skilled the caster, the longer the Elemental can stay manifested.

Summon Moonfang: advanced level spell, school of Conjuration

Summon Moonfang is a beast conjuring spell that summons a loyal, large spectral wolf known as a Moonfang. This advanced spell requires a clear night sky and the caster to have a deep connection with the natural world. The Moonfang can be commanded to attack foes, scout terrain, or protect the caster.

Bind Familiar: advanced level spell, school of Conjuration

Bind Familiar is a Conjuration spell that summons a permanent magical creature to serve the caster for a lifetime. The spell requires the caster to pour a portion of their own life force into the spell, binding the familiar to their service while also linking their life forces. The familiar's form depends on the caster's personality, magical proficiency, and intended usage. Common forms include mythical creatures like griffins, phoenixes, or fae sprites, but also include lesser known magical beasts. While the summoned familiar is extremely loyal, this spell holds inherent risks, as the linked life-force means that harm to the familiar can and will affect the caster as well.

Bind Greater Familiar: master level spell, school of Conjuration

Bind Greater Familiar is a powerful Conjuration spell that establishes a permanent bond with a potent magical entity, creating a lifelong ally for the caster. This colossal endeavor entails more than simple summoning. The master wizard must pour into the ritual not only their life force but also a portion of their soul, establishing an irrevocable link between themselves and the familiar. The summoned entity is typically a high-ranking celestial, infernal, or elemental creature, whose form and abilities are directly influenced by the nature and power of the caster. As with the Bind Familiar spell, the summoner's fate remains inseparably linked with their familiar. However, the scale of power—along with the risk—is significantly greater. To cast this spell irresponsibly could invite disaster, yet if executed successfully, it allows the caster access to the familiar's immense power and wisdom.

Archangel Manifestation: master level spell, school of Conjuration

Archangel Manifestation is a Conjuration spell that calls fourth a celestial being – specifically, an archangel. A difficult spell to master, it requires not just superior magical ability but also good intentions. The Archangel appears under the caster’s control for a short time, providing guidance or combating powerful foes. Yet, as celestial creatures of free will, the Archangel will resist and potentially punish attempts to have it commit evil deeds.

Summon Infernal Revenant: master level spell, school of Conjuration

Summon Infernal Revenant is a chilling spell that calls forth a powerful demon from the nether realms. Only the most capable and brave conjurers dare attempt this spell, as it calls for exceptional magical mastery and a substantial power exchange. With it, the caster can command the summoned demon to perform various tasks, from sharing infernal knowledge to engaging in fearsome battle. Yet, the demon remains independent and cunning, ever-ready to exploit any lapse in the spellcaster's control. This spell is perilous and can have dire, unforeseeable consequences if mishandled. It’s considered as one of the most powerful conjurations within dark magic traditions.

Harbinger's Call: Peak level spell, school of Conjuration

Harbinger's Call is a spell entrenched in whispers and mystery, its very existence only speculative in the most ancient Conjuration texts. Legend has it, this spell summons forth the Architect of Realities, a hooded entity said to exist outside the boundaries of time and space, only believed to have been contacted once before. Its power is such that, once cast, the caster and the Architect forge a link, enabling them to reshape the fabric of reality to mirror their heart's deepest desires. The universe-altering consequences of such a deity aligning with mortal ambition make this a spell potentially hazardous to all of existence. However, the immense difficulty in both the casting process and surviving the aftermath has thankfully left the Harbinger's Call unrealized, preserving it as a terrifying legend rather than a catastrophic reality.

Shadow Flush: amateur level spell, school of Necromancy 

Shadow Flush is a harmless yet effective spell that creates shadows to dance and move according to the caster's command. It’s primarily used as a parlor trick or to add atmosphere to a more dramatic event. Aside from requiring a simple incantation, the spell demands little energy from the caster, making it accessible to anyone willing to put time into studying the basics of Necromancy.

Whispers of the Departed: beginner level spell, school of Necromancy 

Whispers of the Departed allows a Necromancer to hear faint whispers from the spirit world, usually utilized in crude attempts at communicating with the dead. With increased skill, this spell can yield more intelligible messages and can be used to gather information from those who have passed on. Special attention and study in recognizing the distance and volume of the whispers increase the accuracy of the spell.

Raise Lesser Undead: moderate level spell, school of Necromancy 

Raise Lesser Undead is a necromantic spell that requires an above-average amount of magical aptitude. Once mastered, the caster can summon and control up to a half dozen of lesser undead servants such as skeletons or zombies. These can be called upon to do basic tasks or used as a defensive force. This spell requires extensive practice and a deep understanding of life force manipulation.

Kiss of Desolation: advanced level spell, school of Necromancy 

A menacing spell, Kiss of Desolation slowly drains life energy from a target, reducing them to a weakened or deceased state depending on how long they are subjected to it. The energy is then absorbed by the caster, rejuvenating them and prolonging their life. This spell is incredibly challenging to manipulate, requiring a unique balance of life force power control. Only proficient necromancers with an in-depth understanding of life and death forces can successfully employ this spell.

Raise Greater Undead: master level spell, school of Necromancy

Raise Greater Undead is a terrifying display of necromantic might. It allows the caster to summon and control more powerful undead beings such as wraiths or vampires. This spell can also be employed to resurrect a singular, stronger, highly intelligent undead creature like a death night or even a lich. Not only does this require an incredible understanding and control over life force, but it also demands a dominant willpower to command the summoned creatures. In some cases, the caster may need to know the name of the deceased they wish to resurrect, when the deceased person was a strong-willed individual in their life. This spell is thus a testament to the mastery of the necromancer capable of its use.

Grasp Heart: master level spell, school of Necromancy

Grasp Heart is a grim and perilous spell that instantly snuffs out the life force of a targeted individual, providing no physical evidence of foul play. The caster reaches out with their arcane energy, figuratively reaching into the chest of the target and squeezing their heart, causing it to stop abruptly. This spell represents a highly malevolent and dreadfully powerful application of Necromancy’s focus on the energies of life and death, requiring both an enormous magical aptitude and a ruthless intent. The power and unavoidability of this spell make it a rare and feared tool in the Necromancer's arsenal.

Ascension to Lichdom: master level spell, school of Necromancy

The spell Ascension to Lichdom is a profound and dangerous ritual that imbues the caster with the dark power required to transform themselves into a Lich - an undead entity of immense necromantic power, feared for their ability to stay immortal by continually capturing and consuming souls. Casting this spell requires an object of great personal significance referred to as a 'Phylactery' where the necromancer's own soul will reside, facilitating their transformation into an undead being and thereby escaping the mortality of human life. This spell demands a rich understanding of the taboo manipulation of life essence, a ceaseless pursuit for forbidden knowledge, and bravery in the face of the unknown. A Necromancer who successfully casts this spell seals their fate, trading their humanity for undying power and immortality.

Transcendence to Demilichdom: peak level spell, school of Necromancy

The spell of Transcendence to Demilichdom is a propitious mission into the very borders of the arcane abyss, reserved only for those legendary liches who have mastered the mysteries of life, death, and eternity. This spell allows a lich to ascend even further into the realm of the undead and become a demilich, an even more feared, powerful, and nearly indestructible entity that has transcended the need for a physical body.

The lich is required to create eight soul gems, artifacts of immeasurable power, which will serve as new phylacteries, storing their consciousness. This requires the lich to replace small parts of their body (eyes, teeth, finger joints, etc.)  with these soul gems. Once this spell is cast, the physical body of the lich, no longer needed, disintegrates into dust, leaving only the part of the body housing the soul gems intact, usually the skull.

The soul gems now act as the demilich's phylactery, making them nearly invincible as the demilich and soul gems will reappear after "death" or destruction after ten days unless all soul gems and the original phylactery are destroyed within the ten days before the demilich reappears. This spell requires an extraordinary understanding of the nature of magic and reality, a feat only attainable by a select few entities in history. A lich who ascends to demilichdom with successful casting of this spell becomes an unparalleled force of necromantic magic, casting off the few remaining shackles of mortality and embodying everlasting power.

Desolation's Doorstep: peak level spell, school of Necromancy 

Perhaps the most impressive display of necromantic power is the spell Desolation's Doorstep. This apocalyptic spell allows the caster to rip open a gateway directly into the realm of the dead. This ruthless door spreads death and decay around its location and can pull the living into its twilight realm or release the spirits of the dead into the world of the living. Only the most legendary of necromancers can even attempt to cast this spell.

Eclipse of Souls: peak level spell, school of Necromancy

Eclipse of Souls is a spell reserved only for the most exceptionally gifted and daring necromancers. By casting it, a necromancer can take control of a large number of souls temporarily, effectively creating an army of ethereal entities compelled to follow the caster's commands. The souls can also be compelled to possess the bodies of the deceased, creating a spectral army under the necromancer's control. However, manipulating such an immense amount of life force comes with significant risks, as losing control of the spell can result in catastrophic consequences, potentially even trapping the caster's own soul amongst the ocean of ensnared spirits. Only the most fearless and talented necromancers can even attempt to wrangle the immense power required for this spell.

Glowing Palm: amateur level spell, school of Vitalization

Glowing Palm is used primarily for plant care. By channeling their innate magical energy into their hands and then touching a withering plant directly, the Vitalizer can rejuvenate the life within it. The plant will start to show signs of improvement instantaneously, slowly getting its green color back and standing upright. This spell does not work on more complex life forms such as animals and humans.

Heal Minor Wound: beginner level spell, school of Vitalization

Heal Minor Wound is fundamental spell to any aspiring Vitalizer; it marks the starting point of healing others. Once cast, the spell allows the caster to mend small cuts and scrapes. By placing their hands above the wound, a warm, soothing energy is directed towards the injury, promoting faster healing. The injury seals itself up almost immediately, leaving no trace of scarring.

Life Vein: moderate level spell, school of Vitalization

The spell Life Vein helps against diseases. When laid on a diseased body, the Vitalizer's hands turn vividly fluorescent green, and a pulse of energy flows into the body, targeting and nullifying the disease microbes. The effects of the spell are not instant, but in most cases, the patient reports feeling significantly better within a few hours.

Accelerated Vitalization: advanced level spell, school of Vitalization

Accelerated Vitalization allows the caster to rapidly speed up the ageing process of any living organism. When used correctly, it can assist in quickly growing crops or maturing animals. However, if used malevolently or improperly this spell can lead to the rapid premature death of the target organism as it organically ages beyond its natural lifespan swiftly.

Heal Wound: advanced level spell, school of Vitalization

Heal Wound is a spell reserved for those deeply attuned to the forces of life and regeneration. Designed to mend serious injuries, such as deep gashes, broken bones, and heavy burns, this spell can save lives on the battlefield or in perilous situations. The caster places their hands over the wound and draws upon the natural life force surrounding them. A warm, gentle energy cascades from their palms into the wound, accelerating the healing process to an incredible degree. The skin knits together, bones mend, and in mere moments, the injury is healed without a scar left behind. However, casting this spell consumes a vast amount of energy and requires careful control over the healing process, making it hard to master.

Ethereal Revivification: master level spell, school of Vitalization

Ethereal Revivification is a rare spell capable of regenerating lost limbs or even vital organs in a living being. The spell creates a mystical aura that mimics the genetic behavior of the subject, resulting in organic growth to replace the missing body parts. It requires a remarkably skilled caster and immense energy to revive and mend such complicated life structures.

Verdant Genesis: peak level spell, school of Vitalization

Verdant Genesis is the pinnacle of Vitalization magic, capable of breathing life into the lifeless. This spell allows the caster to regenerate dead organic matter, restoring life with memories intact, however if the soul of the body has been destroyed or captured the body will remain in a vegetative state unless it's soul is able to return. Casting this spell is considered a miracle even amongst the most experienced Vitalizers. However, using this spell is also controversial, treading the fine line between natural order and magic. It requires immense magical aptitude.

Glowbloom: amateur level spell, school of Evocation

Glowbloom harnesses the raw energy of magic to phase a small, incandescent orb of light into existence. Often used as a stepping stone in learning to manipulate pure magical energy, the size and radiance of the orb will fluctuate based on the caster's control and focus. Though it appears as a simple trick, it provides a novice clear evidence of their ability to evoke magic.

Magic Pulse: beginner level spell, school of Evocation

Magic Pulse lets the caster send out a silent, invisible wave of pure magical energy reaching up to a mile in radius, allowing them to detect the presence and approximate position of other spells or magical beings in effect within the area. This spell is excellent for understanding the ebb and flow of magical currents in the environment and requires the magic user to calibrate their own magical pulses precisely.

Harmonium Vertex: moderate level spell, school of Evocation 

Harmonium Vertex allows the caster to weave a complex structure of pure, resonating magic energy that traps anything within its bounds. This resonation can be finely tuned for a variety of effects such as putting beings to sleep, dulling their senses, or even causing physical pain. Fine control and deep understanding of resonant principles are required to cast this spell effectively.

Radiant Beam: moderate level spell, school of Evocation

Radiant Beam is an offensive spell. The user generates a concentrated beam of unrefined magical energy. The beam formed by this spell is typically used for staving off threats or dueling fellow magic users. The spell demands intense concentration, discipline, and a fundamental understanding of the raw essence of magic.

Morphic Aegis: advanced level spell, school of Evocation

The spell Morphic Aegis is a remarkable demonstration of Evocation control. A caster who masters this spell can summon a nearly impervious shield of raw magical energy in a shape of their design that provides robust protection against both magical and physical attacks. The shield maintains a constant connection to the caster, who must pour their energy into it to maintain its structure and power. The shield not only blocks incoming attacks, but it can also absorb a fair portion of the energy from those attacks to replenish itself, an essential factor considering the drain this spell can put on casters. Morphic Aegis is a testament to protection through absolute command over the raw essence of magic.

Pulsar Burst: master level spell, school of Evocation

Pulsar Burst is a remarkable representation of the apex of power and control over raw magical energy. The caster, channeling their own life energy intermingled with the essence of pure magic, unleashes a concentrated beam of magnificent yet deadly magic, resembling the radiant energy released by stars. The beam pierces through anything in its path, obliterating everything to its foundational elements and has the ability to decimate even the toughest armor or protective spells. Due to the excessive amount of energy required, the use of Pulsar Burst is extremely taxing and can even be lethal to the caster if not properly controlled. Despite the potential toll it takes on the caster's vitality, the raw destructive power it unleashes has led to its prestige as a symbol of mastery in Evocation spell-casting.

Omnicreation Astrum: peak level spell, school of Evocation 

The spell Omnicreation Astrum is a testament to the overwhelming prowess of its caster. This spell lets the caster create a miniature star of pure magical energy fusion. This burning sphere can provide near limitless magical energy, enough to power whole cities or realms. However, the detrimental effects of losing control over this spell are catastrophic, often resulting in the eradication of vast swaths of land. Only the most skilled and powerful magic users are capable of even considering casting Omnicreation Astrum.

Shape Stone: amateur level spell, school of Transmutation

This is a simple spell that allows the caster to soften and reshape up to a cubic foot of stone into any shape the caster can envision. Though its effects are rudimentary, it is a useful tool for stonemasons and sculptors, or for anyone in need of a handy rock-paperweight or doorstop.

Aquatic Adaptation: beginner level spell, school of Transmutation

The Aquatic Adaptation spell transmutes the user's lungs to extract oxygen from water, akin to the gills of a fish, thus allowing them to breathe underwater. The spell also alters the user's eyes for excellent underwater vision by introducing a subtle membrane to protect the eyes from water pressure and saline content, as well as altering light perception to allow clarity in low-light aquatic environments. Additionally, the user's skin takes on a slight fast-drying quality, ensuring the caster isn't waterlogged after emerging.

Beast Tongue: moderate level spell, school of Transmutation

Beast Tongue, always popular among animal lovers, alters the caster's vocal cords to imitate the sounds and calls of any animal they have heard before. Additionally, the spell gifts the caster rudimentary understanding of animal speech, enabling simple, basic conversations with creature of the wild.

Ironform: Advanced level spell, school of Transmutation

Ironform renders the caster's skin into a flexible, yet metallic and highly durable substance akin to iron. While under the effects of this spell, the caster becomes highly resistant to physical harm, capable of shrugging off blows that would cripple or even kill a normal man.

Gaze of the Gorgon: advanced level spell, school of Transmutation

Much like the power of the legendary monsters, the Grasp of the Gorgon imbues the caster's gaze with the power to turn victims to stone. Upon meeting the eyes of the caster while the spell is activate, any creature is instantly transmuted into a lifeless statue of rock. This petrifying gaze persists as long as the caster maintains concentration, a demanding task amidst the tumult of conflict or when confronting several foes. The stony fate is permanent, barring intervention from the original caster or another transmutationist possessing adequate skill and power to reverse the spell's effect.

Beast Form: advanced level spell, school of Transmutation.

The Beast Form spell grants the caster the extraordinary ability to transmute their form into that of any lesser creature. Whether they wish to gallop through open fields as a stallion or dive into oceans as a dolphin, this spell enables a variety of transformations, offering a unique approach to exploration and evasion. 

Upon invocation, the caster's body takes on the physical characteristics of the chosen animal, reflecting every detail from size to inherent abilities. For instance, if they opt for the guise of a bird, not only would they gain feathers and a beak, but also the aptitude for swift and agile flight. Should they prefer an aquatic creature, they would possess gills and fins suited for life underwater. 

However, the spell doesn't extend to higher-order magical creatures or mythical beasts. Its essence lies in replicating the simpler, raw forms of life, hence keeping the transformation within the bounds of natural, non-magical creatures. It's worth noting that even while enveloped in a beast’s form, the caster retains their intellect and sense of self, enabling strategic exploitation of their animalistic abilities.

Greater Beast Form: master level spell, school of Transmutation.

The Greater Beast Form spell represents an elevated competency in transmutation, allowing the caster to adopt the form of formidable magical beasts. This enchantment takes them beyond the boundaries of simple, natural creatures and into the myriad forms of the magical world's most rugged beasts.

The spell imbues on the caster the physical traits of chosen magical beings, whether they desire the razor-sharp senses of a griffon, the handy amorphous nature of an ooze, or the mystifying camouflage of a displacer beast. The fidelity of the transformation is impeccable, reflecting each detail and inherent capability of the chosen beast, from the exact texture of their hide to their distinct battle prowess. 

However, this transmutation retains the linearity of the physical realm, bestowing no augmented intellectual or magical capabilities beyond the base instincts and knowledge of the adopted form. Moreover, it respects a natural barrier by limiting the enchantment to exclude ancient, immortal, and supremely powerful creatures such as dragons.

The caster's intellect and self-awareness are preserved throughout the transformation. This spell allows for strategic exploitation of the chosen beast's capabilities, providing the practitioners with a diverse and potent arsenal of physical abilities to explore or combat the challenges of the world.

Draconic Genesis: peak level spell, school of Transmutation.

Draconic Genesis is a profoundly powerful incantation that causes the caster to undergo a metamorphosis leaving them as a true dragon. The dragon species the caster evolves into aligns seamlessly with their innate nature. Virtuous and benevolent beings transform into gleaming metallic dragons like the altruistic and wise gold or the regal and just silver, while those nurtured by chaos or malice become vibrant, powerful chromatic dragons like the particularly ruthless black or manipulative blue.

As a dragon, the caster inherits all the mystical and natural prowess synonymous with these legendary creatures. They effortlessly hover through the skies on majestic wings, unleash breath weapons resembling their dragon type's elemental might, and their skin bristles with resilient scales that are nigh impenetrable.

While their unprecedented transmutation skills mean the caster maintains the ability to revert to their previous form or assume new ones, their true species is now fundamentally dragon. This metamorphosis goes beyond the surface. The caster inherits the dragon's innately enhanced intellect, becoming privy to a level of knowledge and wisdom revered in the annals of magic.

The caster also retains the dragon's supreme power and sagacity across all their transformations. Their profound strength, potent magic resistance, and an ageless lifespan remain omnipresent elements of their existence. This enduring embodiment of draconic traits, even outside the dragon form, forever elevates the caster into a realm of formidable arcane might, uncharted by ordinary beings. The Draconic Genesis spell serves as a testament to the apex of transmutation magic, a manifestation of the wisdom, power, and eternal essence of dragonhood.

Fleeting Whisper: amateur level spell, school of Animurgy

As an amateur spell, Fleeting Whisper allows the caster to send a brief, silent message to a target in their line of sight. This message recipient would hear the message as if it was whispered in their ear, but only the sender and the recipient are privy to it. This spell is a fundamental method of communication used by animurgist, often for secretly conveying warnings or instructions.

Glimpse of Dreams: beginner level spell, school of Animurgy

This spell lets the caster enter another person's dream, observing it like a spectator without influencing the dream itself. The target must be asleep and in the same vicinity as the caster. Glimpse of Dreams can be used to understand a person's subconscious thoughts and emotions, and is often employed in therapeutic settings. Prolonged use of this spell can blur the boundaries between dream and reality for the caster, making it necessary for animurgists to exercise caution while using it.

Dreamweaver: moderate level spell, school of Animurgy

By employing the forces of the spell Dreamweaver, the caster can gently infiltrate the subconscious mind of a sleeping individual, navigating their dreamscape and subtly altering the course of their dreams. Through this, users may plant suggestions or induce specific scenarios for the dreamer, ultimately molding their impending actions. This spell requires precise control and delicate manipulation to avoid causing nightmares or mental disturbances. Do note, the dreamer's inner defenses might fight against the external influence, making the outcome somewhat unpredictable.

Phantasm Forge: advanced level spell, school of Animurgy

Phantasm Forge allows the caster to create powerful illusions in the mind of other creatures, shaping their perceptions and potentially creating entire realities that exist only in their minds. This potent and complex spell requires great skill to cast, but its effects can be overwhelmingly powerful, used in both harmless ways to create beautiful scenarios or dangerous ways to create nightmarish realities for enemies.

Mind Quell: master level spell, school of Animurgy

A fearsome spell of deadly consequence, Mind Quell allows the caster to invade the mind of another living creature and shut down their mental functions, effectively causing instantaneous death. When cast, the targeted mind is overwhelmed with psychic energy which disrupts cognitive processes, causing all brain function to cease within seconds. Due to its morally dubious nature, Mind Quell is typically only known or used by those of a more malicious disposition. This spell is often strictly forbidden and heavily sanctioned by magical guilds or societies.

Mind Arcanum: master level spell, school of Animurgy

Mind Arcanum of Oblivion is a highly advanced spell that allows the caster to manipulate or erase specific memories from the mind of a living creature. The spell is dangerous and difficult to control, as improperly cast spells may result in unintended memory wipes. Still, used by expert animurgists, it can alter the course of a person's history, turning enemies into friends or wiping out traumatic experiences.

Soul Dominion: peak level spell, school of Animurgy

Soul Dominion is a legendary spell said to be known by only a handful of the most powerful animurgists in history. In its most powerful form, the spell gives the caster complete control over another individual's soul, allowing them to manipulate their thoughts, emotions, and actions like a puppeteer controlling a marionette. The unsettling aspect of this spell is that its victims rarely realize they are under another's control, believing all actions and thoughts to be their own.

Echoes of the Past: moderate level spell, school of Animurgy

The caster using the Echoes of the Past spell can tap into the residual psychic imprints left by individuals on their personal belongings. By doing so, the user experiences short fragments of memories related to the object -- not comprehensive narratives, but fleeting images, sounds, and feelings. This can be used to glean hidden information or understand certain aspects of individuals who are no longer available. Using this spell ideally requires a calm mind and a focused intention, as the resonating echoes may prove overwhelming if mishandled.

Soulweaver’s Sonata: advanced level spell, school of Animurgy.

This spell creates an ethereal harmony, allowing the caster to touch and interact with souls. Soulweaver's Sonata can conjure the lost souls of the departed to ask them questions, persuade them for a favor, pseudo-physically interact with them, or even guide them into the afterlife. This spectrum of capabilities has made this spell both a boon and a curse; while it provides closure, it often leads to devastating encounters with regret or guilt.

Mind's Mirror: advanced level spell, school of Animurgy.

Mind's Mirror enables the caster to navigate through the various layers of another’s psyche, gaining access to their every thought, desire, and fear. The caster assumes a passive observer role, gleaning insights without influencing or alerting the subject of their perusal. This spell demands intense concentration and emotional fortitude, as navigating through another's mind presents the risk of being overwhelmed by foreign mental landscapes. Mind's Mirror can be a powerful tool for truth-seeking or deep understanding of an individual's psyche.

Slumber's Grasp: advanced level spell, school of Animurgy.

Slumber's Grasp seizes the mind of the target and draws them into immediate, deep sleep, regardless of their current state or surroundings. Unlike lesser sleep-inducing spells, this one does not gradually ease the target into unconsciousness but thrusts them instantaneously into deep slumber.

Emotion's Brush: moderate level spell, School of Animurgy.

By casting Emotion's Brush, an animurgist gains the ability to dynamically influence the overall emotional landscape of an individual. Similar to painting with a paint bruch, the caster can each stroke subtly amplify, mitigate, or even introduces new emotions into the target's psyche. This spell can be utilized for therapeutic purposes, such as damping down overwhelming feelings of sorrow or anxiety. However, in more malicious hands, it can be used to unsettle and manipulate individuals.

Whispers of the Departed: moderate level spell, school of Animurgy.

Whispers of the Departed is a spell that facilitates an unpredictable line of communication with the deceased. The spell summons the vague impression of a soul, and the caster can attempt to interact with it. Information obtained can be accurate, misleading, or even completely nonsensical, entirely dependent on the wayward whims of the echo and its coherence at the time of summoning. Despite being highly unreliable, Whispers of the Departed offers a rare opportunity to connect with those beyond the mortal realm, making it an intriguing, if precarious, tool for less skilled animurgists.
